description: Quest facts the sources get wrong or leave out, each with the page that shows it. Applied by the build after all sources (internal/build/fixes.go).

fixes.note: Wet Job is taken at the Mound of Dirt that ends Scramble
Stepping Stones is taken where the note is handed in: the Horde at the Nailed Plank in Westfall, the Alliance at the remains in the Barrens
the Alliance takes the note at the Burned-Out Remains in Westfall (Alexston Farmstead) and hands it in at the ones in the Barrens
Confounding Flash (gnome priest racial): taken from High Priestess Mims in Ironforge, handed in by speaking to her again
Divine Grace (human priest racial): High Priestess Laurena in Stormwind gives and takes it; the reward is the spell, nothing to do between (as Confounding Flash)

Bloodtalon Matriarch Eggs drop only from the Bloodtalon Matriarch (level 9 raptor), not from Durotar Tigers; confirmed in game on 5 November

Need for a Cure is taken from Rhinag first and handed in with the Venomtail Antidote that Finding the Antidote gives; the sources had the chain reversed (confirmed in game on 5 November: Kor'ghan does not offer Finding the Antidote without it)
Kor'ghan offers Finding the Antidote only while Need for a Cure is in the log (confirmed in game on 5 November)

Halikor, whose drop Halikor's Hoof starts the quest, is an elite level 12 thunder lizard at Thunder Ridge (Chained Bolt); the sources list it as a plain creature; one roaming creature (its many spawn points are its patrol), so Thunder Ridge with its Thunder Lizards is no elite place
Lakota'mani, whose hoof starts the quest, is a level 22 elite kodo in the Barrens (in game: offered to a level 14 character, not killable); the sources list it as a plain creature
